settings.heading: Description
settings.content: Distilled from organically grown Lavandula angustifolia. Floral, herbaceous, and calming — ideal for winding down before sleep.

settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Add 4–6 drops to a diffuser, or dilute with a carrier oil for a pulse-point roll-on. Never apply undiluted to skin.

settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content: 100% Lavandula angustifolia (lavender) essential oil. Nothing else.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free shipping over $50. Ships in 1–2 business days. Unopened bottles returnable within 30 days.

settings.question: Which oil is right for me?
settings.answer: Start with what you want to feel — calm, clear, or energized — and I'll match you. Not sure? The Lavender Calm blend is where most people begin.

settings.question: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.answer: Yes — digital gift cards come in any amount and can be used on oils, massage sessions, or both. They never expire.

settings.question: How do I book a massage?
settings.answer: Head to the booking page, choose a service and a time that suits you, and you'll get a confirmation right away. New clients start with a short intake so I can tailor the session.

settings.question: Can I use these while pregnant?
settings.answer: A few oils aren't recommended during pregnancy. Please check with your provider first, then reach out — I'm glad to point you to the pregnancy-safe blends.

settings.question: Are the oils safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Every blend is diluted in a gentle carrier oil and skips synthetic fragrance entirely. I still recommend a small patch test first, especially if your skin runs reactive.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Right now I ship across the US and Canada, with more regions on the way. Send me a note with your location and I'll let you know what's possible.

settings.heading: Questions? I've got answers.
settings.intro: New to essential oils or booking your first massage? Totally normal to have questions. Here are the ones I hear most — and if yours isn't here, just reach out.
